pr_body:
This fixes the way we check for Warnings in SingleValueQueryTests, to account for tests that require full data set scans outside the range the inner query filters for.

Fixes #102997, #103360.
pr_comments: @nik9000, when you have a few spare moments, could you have a look over this? thanks!
